d.description: real-valued array of shape ``(N,)`` specifying the diagonal elements.

e.description: real-valued array of shape ``(N - 1,)`` specifying the off-diagonal elements.

eigvals_only.description: If True, return only the eigenvalues (default: False). Computation of eigenvectors is not yet implemented, so ``eigvals_only`` must be set to True.

select.description: specify which eigenvalues to calculate. Supported values are:

constraints: select_range must be one of i

tol.description: absolute tolerance to use when solving for the eigenvalues.

key.description: a PRNG key, as returned by ``jax.random.key``, used to generate random initialization vectors for inverse iteration. If ``None``, defaults to a fixed PRNG key.

output.description: An array of eigenvalues with shape ``(N,)``.
